description: Update a Pipedrive activity — e.g. set done:1 to mark it complete, or change due_date/due_time to reschedule. Pass any additional Pipedrive field in `fields`, keyed by its field key/name (call the matching list_pipedrive_*_fields tool first to discover custom field keys and, for enum/set fields, their option ids). INVITATIONS (ticket 442c7dd3): Pipedrive e-mails a calendar invitation to the GUESTS (fields.attendees: [{email_address, name}]) through the calendar sync of the activity OWNER (user_id). So to put a colleague on a site visit, keep the owner a user with Pipedrive calendar sync (usually the one who books it, e.g. the office manager) and add the colleague as attendee — do NOT just switch user_id to the colleague: then they are owner and organizer of their own event and nobody is invited. Set attendees when CREATING the activity; guests added later by an update are not reliably invited. Never set org_id to the own company. If a guest must be invited to an existing activity and did not get the invitation, create a new activity with the guest instead of patching the old one.

activity_id.description: ID of the activity to change

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

name: update_pipedrive_activity
